fact: The Corporate and Business Registration Department portal offers online 'Register your business', incorporation of a company, a business registration number and online trade fee payment.
system: Corporate and Business Registration Department online services portal

fact: The Corporate and Business Registration Department's April 2025 online guide describes incorporating companies and registering businesses through online forms with documents uploaded.
system: Corporate and Business Registration Department online registration

fact: CBRD's annual report counts 8,565 companies incorporated online in 2024/25 (for example 868 online against 318 at the office in July 2024).
CBRD says VAT registration is performed through CBRIS at the same time as company incorporation, whenever applicable, since May 2021.
